{{Quote|Looks like the pro-Imperial corporations have taken matters into their own hands and have hired a bounty hunter to bring me in. They've spared no expense, apparently, since they've hired a particularly dangerous lady by the name of Kalia Kulmina. She's a Zabrak and she's as deadly as she is beautiful. Think you could stop her from making me into a statistic?|Garm Bel Iblis|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Kalia Kulmina''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kalia Kulmina was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Kalia Kulmina spawned under the generic "bounty_hunter" template, her appearance was randomized under one of five possible depictions. Kulmina could appear as male [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] male wearing [[Ubese raider armor]], a Human female wearing [[Mabari armor]], an [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]], and a female Zabrak wearing [[Bounty Hunter Armor]]. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Kulmina as a female Zabrak, this article assumes that the female Zabrak depiction is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
